parallelize_model_with_fsdp: parallelize a PyTorch model using FSDP full shard with mixed precision and optional tensor parallelism
setup_torch_distributed_for_training: setup torch distributed process group with NCCL backend for single or multi GPU SLURM jobs
get_device_mesh_for_parallelism: get a DeviceMesh for data parallel shard replicate and tensor parallel dimensions from distributed args
dist_reduce_operations: compute distributed max min sum or mean reductions across GPU ranks using torch all_reduce
check_model_value_range: check a PyTorch model parameters and buffers for NaN Inf or suspiciously large value ranges
